scripts.dev: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r --parallel dev
scripts.lint: pnpm db:generate && eslint prisma prisma.config.ts && pnpm -r lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.api:spec: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @devmsr/api build && node apps/api/dist/openapi/generate-spec.js docs/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @devmsr/web api:types
